sloka: आसाद्य रणमध्ये तु वारयित्वा स्थितो ज्वलन् ।धनुर्विस्फारयामास कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.५९.९३ ।।।।
transliteration: āsādya raṇamadhye tu vārayitvā sthito jvalan ।dhanurvisphārayāmāsa kampayanniva medinīm ।। 6.59.93 ।।।।

translations.english: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.
